dependencyContract.comparisonModel: Require exactly one polarClassRequirementsApplicable boolean. If true, require valid polarClass evidence and constrain every linked internalIceStrengthenedStructure to have one QuantityValue internalStructureCorrosionAbrasionAddition with decimal numericValue >= 1.0 and exactly one unit:MilliM. If false, the I2.11.3 obligation is non-applicable. The universal rule does not require a structure instance.
